title: AI Unsheathed: Testing Human-AI Collaboration Through Deck Construction in Competitive Strategy Games

contributions.purpose: 以已知答案问题检验 AI 在竞技策略游戏中的推理与情境判断
contributions.mechanism: 用集换式卡牌游戏 Flesh and Blood 英雄 Kassai 为测试域,分四假设(元游戏识别/主板构筑/卡牌评估/备牌设计)让 ChatGPT 逐步构筑套牌并与社区共识对比
contributions.evaluation: 定性对比 AI 估计与 Pro Tour Singapore/Week 1 基准及社区共识,四假设全部评估,无统计显著性检验
contributions.domain: 人机协作 / 实验经济学 / 集换式卡牌游戏
contributions.source_quote: the study evaluates whether AI can navigate both formal constraints and contextual judgment through four hypotheses: metagame identification, mainboard construction, card evaluation, and sideboard design.

contributions.purpose: 揭示 AI 在结构性推理与情境适应上的系统性缺陷
contributions.mechanism: 分析 AI 的元游戏估计、卡牌角色分类与备牌构筑错误
contributions.evaluation: AI 系统性低估主导策略、误分类卡牌角色(如把 Braveforge Bracers 标为 Staple)、无法识别备牌功能,反映在线来源偏差
contributions.source_quote: it systematically underestimates dominant strategies, misclassifies card roles, and fails to anticipate dynamic shifts in the competitive environment. Its outputs reflect biases inherited from online sources.

contributions.purpose: 定位人机协作的边界:AI 擅长综合但需专家监督
contributions.mechanism: 以四假设结果归纳 AI 的能力与局限
contributions.evaluation: AI 能组织信息、综合共识知识、产出结构化输出,但准确性依赖共识质量;专家监督对准确性/情境意识/战略深度不可或缺
contributions.source_quote: AI can serve as a valuable assistant in knowledge synthesis, but expert oversight remains indispensable to ensure accuracy, contextual awareness, and strategic depth.

notes: 核心是负结果:AI 复现描述性模式但缺结构性推理,系统性低估主导策略、误判卡牌角色、备牌设计失败;共识错则 AI 亦错(继承人类偏见)。非典型实证论文:无统计检验,评估全为定性对比+专家判断,'known-answer question'设计。四元组基本套得上但 evaluation 无量化数字(定性判定),已在此说明。decision=reject。
